data: What is the research question being addressed in this figure, and how is it depicted in the figure?

The research question being addressed in this figure is about the conditional entropies (H) and mutual information quantities (MI) of three linguistic features: form (W), meaning (V), and declension class (C), given gender (G) in German and Czech. 

The figure depicts this through a Venn diagram with three overlapping circles representing H(W|G), H(V|G), and H(C|G). The intersection areas represent the mutual information quantities MI(C;W|G), MI(C;V|G), MI(C;W,V|G), and MI(C;W,V|G). The values for these quantities are provided in the table on the right side of the figure, with separate columns for German and Czech.
